definitions.explanation: A system where customers serve themselves rather than being served by staff. Common in gas stations, restaurants, and stores.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}はセルフサービスです。
セルフサービスのガソリンスタンドで{給油|きゅうゆ}した。
examples.english: I filled up at a self-service gas station.

examples.japanese: {食堂|しょくどう}はセルフサービスなので、{自分|じぶん}でトレーを{片付|かたづ}けてください。
examples.english: The cafeteria is self-service, so please put away your own tray.

notes:
USAGE:
A wasei-eigo (Japanese-coined English) term widely used in Japan. Often shortened to セルフ in casual speech (セルフのガソリンスタンド). Self-service gas stations have become increasingly common in Japan since their legalization in 1998.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- セルフサービスの{店|みせ} (self-service shop)
- セルフサービス{方式|ほうしき} (self-service system)
- セルフサービスのレジ (self-checkout register)
